name: Craxast Mattar
ingredients_raw: Peas (74%), Edible Vegetable Oils (Refined Palmolein Oil and Refined Cotton Seed Oil), *Seasoning (Maltodextrin, Onion Powder, Coriander Powder, Chilli Powder, Cumin Powder, Amchur Powder, Garlic Powder, Black Pepper Powder, Mace Powder, Clove Powder, Nutmeg Powder, Cardamom Powder, Cinnamon Powder, Spices Extract), Iodized Salt, Black Salt, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Yeast Extract, Anticaking Agent (INS 551), Natural Colour (INS 100(i)), Synthetic Colour (INS 133), Flavour(s) (Natural & Nature Identical Flavouring Substances). *Used as part of flavouring agent. May contain Nut, Wheat and Soy.
